class.name: CheatManager
class.brief_description: A player's cheat commands, run on the server.
class.description: Every [PlayerController] has one ([method PlayerController.get_cheat_manager]), made from [code]application/game_framework/debug/cheat_manager_script[/code] or this class. Every public method of it is a console command - in a script extending [CheatManager], [code]func give_money(amount: int = 100)[/code] is typed as [code]give_money 500[/code]. Methods starting with [code]_[/code] are not commands. Cheats always run on the server, on the cheating player's own cheat manager: [method get_player_controller] is the player who typed it, and whatever the method changes is authoritative and replicates as usual. [method client_message] sends text back to that player's console. [method _get_command_help] gives each command a one-line help text. Built-in cheats: [method teleport], [method where], [method set_movement_mode] and the [code]gas_*[/code] ones, which act on the pawn's [AbilitySystemComponent].

method.name: _get_command_help
method.description: Return a one-line help text for the command [param name], or an empty string.

method.name: client_message
method.description: Prints [param text] in the console of the player who ran the cheat.

method.name: gas_add_tag
method.description: Adds a loose gameplay tag to the pawn's ability system.

method.name: gas_apply_effect
method.description: Applies the [GameplayEffect] at [param effect_path] to the pawn.

method.name: gas_grant_ability
method.description: Grants the [GameplayAbility] at [param ability_path] to the pawn.

method.name: gas_remove_tag
method.description: Removes a loose gameplay tag from the pawn's ability system.

method.name: get_ability_system
method.description: The first [AbilitySystemComponent] under the player's pawn, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_command_help
method.description: The help text of a command: [method _get_command_help], else the built-in one.

method.name: get_command_names
method.description: Every method that is a command: the built-in ones and the script's public methods (inherited ones included).

method.name: get_pawn_root
method.description: The root node of the player's pawn, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_player_controller
method.description: The player this cheat manager belongs to.

method.name: set_movement_mode
method.description: Switches the pawn's [CharacterMovementComponent] to another mode ([code]Walking[/code], [code]Falling[/code], [code]Flying[/code]...).
